pilot0_scope: Human-authored case collection and feasibility only; no treatment superiority claims.

conditions.name: human only
conditions.input: Same original media, declared intent, applicable rubric and extraction access
conditions.assistance: No automated evaluative output; neutral records and timing allowed

conditions.name: human + single automated evaluator
conditions.input: Same evidence budget and human task as A
conditions.assistance: One qualified evaluator configuration; human retains final judgment

conditions.name: human + specialist evaluators
conditions.input: Same evidence and task as B; predeclared matched resource budget
conditions.assistance: Bounded specialists; no intent/hypothesis graph assistance shown

conditions.name: human + specialist evaluators + intent/hypothesis graph
conditions.input: Same specialists, evidence, rubric and declared intent as C
conditions.assistance: Structured relations and competing hypotheses exposed; count graph preparation and review cost

comparison_unit: clip x declared-intent revision x rubric revision x reviewer x assigned condition
assignment: Future preregistered counterbalancing across reviewers and prompt/media families; avoid same-person carryover, or record order and exposure explicitly.
reference_contract: Future independent human reference, blinded to treatment and system outputs, with adjudication and preserved uncertain cases. No gold-set implementation is authorized.
resource_control: Compare matched cost/latency budgets as well as actual cost; repeated single-evaluator sampling is a planned sensitivity comparison, not an additional implemented condition.
analysis_limits: 12-20 purposively selected clips are a feasibility sample. Do not infer model rankings, population accuracy, statistical superiority or causal effects from Pilot 0.
pilot0_sessions: PILOT0_AUTHORING, not condition A: collection may include human-authored hypotheses and graphs, so it is not a clean comparative baseline.
promotion_gate: First human-authored real-media cases must exist before separately authorizing automated judging, adjudicated references, gold sets, regressions or VFX automation.
